scope: source-only audit of official Qwen3-TTS 0.6B German evaluation differences across tokenizer rate and model role; no runtime or F2 acceptance credit
hypothesis: Treating Qwen3-TTS 0.6B as one benchmark condition hides source-reported German differences between Base/CustomVoice and 12Hz/25Hz variants; the F2 TTS benchmark should keep variant identity explicit.
counterhypothesis: The upstream evaluation differences do not transfer to F2 German room dialogue, stable male identity, streaming tails, or whole-resident-body constraints and therefore may not change the local winner.
